### Size

M

### User value

When I send glassware I want to pay for careful handling and see what it costs before I pay.

### Done when

- The form has a "Fragile" checkbox, off by default.
- A fragile parcel costs 2.00 more, in every zone.
- The fee line says "Fee: 6.00 (fragile)" when the box is ticked.
- An empty or too heavy parcel is refused as before, fragile or not.
